newsitem.title: CHINA: China interest in Shun Cheong stake talks.
newsitem.headline: China interest in Shun Cheong stake talks.

text.p: Shun Cheong Holdings Ltd said on Thursday one of its substantial shareholders was in talks to sell a stake in the company to a mainland Chinese partner.

"An approach from an independent third party, who has a connection with mainland China, had been made to Chinney Investments Ltd... to acquire a substantial stake in the company," Shun Cheong said in a statement.
Chinney holds 18.46 percent of Shun Cheong.
"The negotiation is at a preliminary stage and may or may not lead to a change in the control of the company," it said.
The other substantial shareholders of Shun Cheong are New World Trading Ltd, which owns 15.47 percent, and Yau Lee Holdings Ltd, which holds 15 percent.
Shun Cheong shares gained HK$0.03 to HK$0.83 in late morning.
